title: tests/ci/Vagrantfile: multi-distro vagrant test environment
description: Vagrantfile defining VMs for manual multi-distro testing. Define VMs for: ubuntu2204 (Ubuntu 22.04, kernel 5.15), ubuntu2404 (Ubuntu 24.04, kernel 6.8), debian12 (Debian 12, kernel 6.1). Each VM provisions: build dependencies, wolfSSL headers (or full build), and syncs the wolfkm repo. Running 'vagrant up ubuntu2204 && vagrant ssh ubuntu2204' gives a ready build environment.
design: Use virtualbox or libvirt provider. Provisioning script mirrors the apt-get commands from test-on-aws.sh Phase 1. Synced folder: . => /wolfkm. Box images: ubuntu/jammy64, ubuntu/noble64, debian/bookworm64. Memory: 4096 MB, CPUs: 4.
acceptance_criteria: vagrant up ubuntu2204 succeeds. vagrant ssh ubuntu2204 -c 'cd /wolfkm && make -C /lib/modules/$(uname -r)/build M=$(pwd)' succeeds in stub mode.
